rows.grounds: locative adverb indicating the place reached in the preceding verse
bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound qualifying liṅgaṃ; ratna (jewel) + āhvaya (name/called)
bahuvrīhi compound describing the qualified worshipper; vijita (conquered) + indriya (senses)

items.question: What ritual act is required of a sense-conquered practitioner at the liṅga named Ratna?
premises: The practitioner has arrived at that specified place.
A liṅga named Ratna is present there.
The prescribed worshipper is one who has conquered the senses.
items.inference: Therefore, a sense-conquered practitioner should worship the liṅga named Ratna at that place.
items.plain_english: There, one who has conquered the senses should worship the liṅga named Ratna.
